title: Identity-Locked City Portrait Essay
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Documentary City Portrait Essay, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Documentary City Portrait Essay; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-city-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-subway-entry, 03-convenience-store-doorway, 04-stairwell-pause, 05-crosswalk-dusk, 06-bus-stop-night, 07-close-detail-hands, 08-profile-window-reflection, 09-essay-cover-portrait. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
